extra.message: Critical Code Injection vulnerability: User-controlled 'expr' parameter is passed directly to eval() function at line 66. An attacker can execute arbitrary Python code by providing malicious expressions like '__import__("os").system("command")'.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: Critical Command Injection vulnerability: User-controlled 'host' parameter is concatenated directly into an os.system() call at line 121. An attacker can execute arbitrary system commands by injecting shell metacharacters (e.g., '127.0.0.1; cat /etc/passwd').

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability: User-controlled 'url' parameter is passed directly to urllib.request.urlopen() at lines 40-41 without validation. An attacker can make the server send requests to internal services, cloud metadata endpoints, or other restricted resources.

NoSQL Injection vulnerability: User-controlled 'filter' parameter from JSON payload is passed directly to MongoDB's find_one() method at line 129 without sanitization. An attacker can inject MongoDB operators to bypass authentication or extract unauthorized data.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: Path Traversal vulnerability: User-controlled 'name' parameter is used to construct a file path at line 135 and written at line 137. An attacker can use path traversal sequences like '../../../etc/cron.d/malicious' to write files to arbitrary locations on the filesystem.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: Arbitrary File Read vulnerability: User-controlled 'packet_ref' parameter is used to construct a file path at line 30 and read at line 32. An attacker can use path traversal sequences like '../../../etc/passwd' to read arbitrary files from the filesystem.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection vulnerability: The XML parser at lines 150-152 has load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, and no_network=False, which allows external entity resolution. An attacker can exploit this to read local files, perform SSRF, or cause DoS via billion laughs attack.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability: User-controlled 'fragment' parameter is concatenated into a Jinja2 template at line 108. An attacker can inject Jinja2 template syntax like '{{ config }}' or '{{ ''.__class__.__mro__[2].__subclasses__() }}' to access internal objects and potentially achieve RCE.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Template Engines

extra.message: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability: User-controlled 'card' parameter is rendered with Jinja2's '|safe' filter at line 78, which prevents auto-escaping. An attacker can inject malicious HTML/JavaScript like '<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>' that will execute in victims' browsers.

cwe: CWE-80: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags

extra.message: Open Redirect vulnerability: User-controlled 'lane' parameter is used directly in RedirectResponse at line 55 without validation. An attacker can redirect users to malicious external sites (e.g., 'https://evil.com') for phishing attacks.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: Insecure SSL/TLS Configuration: ssl._create_unverified_context() is used at line 144, which disables certificate verification. This makes the application vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks as it will accept any certificate including invalid or malicious ones.

Insecure CORS Configuration: The endpoint reflects the Origin header directly into Access-Control-Allow-Origin at line 94 and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials to 'true' at line 95. This allows any website to make authenticated cross-origin requests, potentially exposing sensitive data.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: Security Misconfiguration: The X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly set to '0' at line 101 and Content-Security-Policy is cleared at line 102. This disables browser XSS protections and removes CSP restrictions, increasing XSS risk.

Hardcoded Cryptographic Key: The SECRET_KEY is hardcoded as 'change-me-in-production-32-char-long-key' at line 6 instead of being loaded from environment variables. This allows attackers who gain access to the source code to forge authentication tokens and impersonate any user.

Hardcoded Credentials: Multiple demo accounts with predictable passwords are hardcoded in seed.py (lines 46-60). These passwords (AdminPass123!, UnderwriterPass123!, etc.) may remain in production systems and allow unauthorized access.

Hardcoded Default Password: All imported borrowers are assigned the same predictable password 'TempPass123!' at line 98. If this seed script is used in production or if passwords aren't changed, attackers can easily guess credentials.

Insecure Cookie Configuration: The access_token cookie is set with secure=False at line 46, meaning it will be sent over unencrypted HTTP connections. This allows attackers to intercept authentication tokens via network sniffing.

cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Flag

extra.message: Insecure Deserialization Pattern: User-controlled JSON payload is directly merged into internal state at line 61 without validation. While this uses dict.update() rather than pickle, it represents an insecure pattern that could allow attackers to modify internal application state.

Potential Denial of Service: The 'amount' parameter at line 47 is converted to int without bounds checking. An attacker could send an extremely large or small value to cause integer overflow, memory issues, or business logic errors.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: Weak Authentication Check: The _wrk_gate function at lines 16-19 has a security weakness - if INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN environment variable is not set, the check 'not gate_value' evaluates to True and access is denied. However, this relies on environment configuration which could be misconfigured or accidentally removed.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Information Exposure: The lendfolio_marker_097 endpoint at lines 23-25 exposes internal folio data including regional identifiers and balance information. While protected by _wrk_gate, if bypassed, this exposes internal loan portfolio organization.
